verdict.rationale: BVNK is stablecoin payments infrastructure, so branded stablecoin issuance is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only accepting, sending, converting and holding existing stablecoins (wallets, on/off-ramps, pay-ins, payouts). Nothing in it describes an issuance product covering minting, redemption or reserve management, or any gating for such a product.
